title: 17 Day Uganda Shoebill Birding Safari
rank_math_title: Uganda Shoebill Birding Safari: 17 Wonderful Days
rank_math_desc: Uganda shoebill birding safari for 17 days: Murchison Falls, Budongo, Kibale, Semliki, Queen Elizabeth, Bwindi, Mburo and Mabamba. Price on request.
post_content: This Uganda shoebill birding safari gives you two chances at the shoebill, plus Murchison Falls, the Royal Mile, five forests and a gorilla trek.
overview:
This Uganda shoebill birding safari is a full loop of Uganda in 17 days. It starts in the north at Murchison Falls, moves through the forests of the west and ends near Lake Victoria, giving you two of the best shoebill sites in the country.

Along the way you bird the famous Royal Mile in Budongo, track chimpanzees in Kibale, search Semliki for Congo Basin birds and trek gorillas in Bwindi.

Why choose this Uganda shoebill birding safari?

  • Murchison Falls: boat trips to the falls and the Nile delta, a top shoebill site.
  • Budongo's Royal Mile: one of Uganda's best forest birding trails.
  • Kibale and Semliki: chimpanzees and rare lowland forest birds.
  • Queen Elizabeth and Bwindi: Kazinga Channel and mountain gorillas.
  • Mabamba and Mabira: a second shoebill chance and a final forest.

Where you stay

Lodges include Lindsay Cottages in Entebbe, Paraa Safari Lodge, Masindi Hotel, Primate Lodge Kibale, Semliki Safari Lodge, Mweya Safari Lodge, Trekker's Tavern at Ruhija, Mihingo Lodge at Lake Mburo, Cassia Lodge in Kampala and Mabira Rainforest Lodge, or similar.

Night drives

Optional night drives at Murchison and Lake Mburo give you a chance at nightjars, owls and nocturnal mammals.

Best time for a Uganda shoebill birding safari

Shoebills are resident and can be seen all year. The drier months from June to August and December to February are easiest for travel and forest walks. The wetter months bring breeding birds and fewer vehicles.

Read about Uganda's top parks in our Uganda national parks guide and plan your trek with our Bwindi gorilla guide. Browse more birding safaris. The Uganda Wildlife Authority manages all the parks on this route.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival in Entebbe
itinerary.content: Airport pick-up and transfer to Lindsay Cottages or Cassia Lodge. Optional birding at the Entebbe Botanical Gardens.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Entebbe to Murchison Falls
itinerary.content: Drive north through the Luwero area with birding stops and continue into Murchison Falls National Park. Overnight at Paraa Safari Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Murchison Falls boat trips
itinerary.content: Boat trips to the base of the falls and to the Nile delta for shoebill, rock pratincole and red-throated bee-eaters, plus a game drive. Optional night drive.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Kaniyo Pabidi to Masindi
itinerary.content: Early birding in the Kaniyo Pabidi forest for Puvel's illadopsis, then grassland birding on the way to Masindi Hotel.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Budongo's Royal Mile
itinerary.content: A full day on the Royal Mile and Busingiro trails for forest birds such as Nahan's francolin and white-thighed hornbill.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Masindi to Kibale
itinerary.content: A long drive via Hoima with stops in papyrus and scrub. Check in at Primate Lodge for two nights.

itinerary.label: Day 7
itinerary.title: Kibale chimpanzees
itinerary.content: Chimpanzee tracking in the morning and forest birding in the afternoon.

itinerary.label: Day 8
itinerary.title: Semliki National Park
itinerary.content: Drive to Semliki for Congo Basin specials such as Nkulengu rail and Congo serpent eagle. Optional night drive. Overnight at Semliki Safari Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 9
itinerary.title: Sempaya to Queen Elizabeth
itinerary.content: Early birding on the Sempaya trail near the hot springs, then drive to Queen Elizabeth National Park. Overnight at Mweya Safari Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 10
itinerary.title: Queen Elizabeth and Kazinga Channel
itinerary.content: A full day of birding and game viewing, with an afternoon boat ride on the Kazinga Channel.

itinerary.label: Day 11
itinerary.title: Queen Elizabeth to Ruhija via Ishasha
itinerary.content: Drive south through Ishasha with its tree-climbing lions, then climb to Ruhija in Bwindi. Overnight at Trekker's Tavern.

itinerary.label: Day 12
itinerary.title: Gorilla trekking at Ruhija
itinerary.content: Track a habituated gorilla family and spend one hour with them. Birding around Ruhija afterwards.

itinerary.label: Day 13
itinerary.title: Ruhija forest birding
itinerary.content: A full day for Albertine Rift endemics such as Rwenzori turaco, regal sunbird and Grauer's warbler.

itinerary.label: Day 14
itinerary.title: Bwindi to Lake Mburo
itinerary.content: Drive to Lake Mburo with birding stops. Afternoon boat ride for African finfoot and herons, and an optional night drive. Overnight at Mihingo Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 15
itinerary.title: Lake Mburo to Kampala
itinerary.content: Morning savannah birding and game drive, then on to Kampala. Overnight at Cassia Lodge or Lindsay Cottages.

itinerary.label: Day 16
itinerary.title: Mabamba Swamp and Mabira Forest
itinerary.content: An early canoe trip at Mabamba for a second chance at the shoebill, then drive east to Mabira Rainforest Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 17
itinerary.title: Mabira Forest and departure
itinerary.content: Morning birding around the lodge, then transfer to Entebbe Airport.
